mission: 'A website for organizing the collection and evaluation of applications for donations to organizations concerned with the long-term survival and flourishing of sentient life.' It runs the 'S-Process' (a recurring algorithmic recommendation meeting), Speculation Grants and Matching Pledges; Jaan Tallinn is the main funder. It reports organising ~$216MM in gifts and grants, including $64MM in 2026.

key_work.title: The S-Process
key_work.plain_summary: A structured process where recommenders score applicants and an algorithm turns their judgements into grant recommendations for participating funders.

warnings.text: Humanity's long-term survival is at stake and needs securing (mission framing).
Frontier labs face pre-deployment security risks such as lab leaks and sandbox exfiltration (ISPA prize rationale).

recommendations.text: Fund organisations working on the long-term survival and flourishing of sentient life via transparent, repeatable grant processes.
Use matching pledges and speculation grants to move money quickly to promising projects.
